purpose: Expose only public-safe proof that Mac Henry learning is governed; never expose private learning state or implementation.
rules: Learning proposals are not authority grants.
Evidence must be verified before it contributes to a governed learning proposal.
Conflicting evidence is surfaced for review rather than silently averaged into strategy.
Major policy or weighting changes require explicit owner approval.
Every major approved change must preserve an auditable prior version and rollback reference.
Public Henry receives governance proof only, never private learning contents.
